_comment: Cards that exist only for the batched attacks-unblocked trigger test (tests/unit/combat/test_batched_attacks_unblocked.py). Never part of a deck list. `t_coveted_jewel` is Coveted Jewel's last ability, with the 'one or more' batching; `t_greedy_jewel` is the same trigger WITHOUT `batched`, and is the counterfactual that pays out once per creature.

cards.name: Test Coveted Jewel
cards.oracle_text: Whenever one or more creatures an opponent controls attack you and aren't blocked, that player draws three cards and gains control of this artifact. Untap it.

abilities.text: Whenever one or more creatures an opponent controls attack you and aren't blocked, that player draws three cards and gains control of this artifact. Untap it.

cards.name: Test Greedy Jewel
cards.oracle_text: Whenever a creature an opponent controls attacks you and isn't blocked, that player draws three cards.

abilities.text: Whenever a creature an opponent controls attacks you and isn't blocked, that player draws three cards.
